Install BioOKF tools

BioOKF Studio requires the bokf CLI and bokf-mcp server. Install the bundled tools so CLI, MCP, registry, and agent workflows work in any terminal. You will be asked for your password once.

Grounded retrieval

Chat with the knowledge base

Select a knowledge base

Ask about mechanisms, evidence, contradictions, provenance, populations, or quantitative findings in the selected KB.
Answers use retrieved BioOKF nodes and preserve evidence URLs. No external web search.
Evidence-backed revision

Knowledge Base Doctor

Select a knowledge base

Transactional revisionDoctor reviews cited papers in an isolated copy, applies only evidence-backed changes, verifies the graph, and creates a reversible Git checkpoint.
Examples: “Recheck the papers supporting the treats edge from X to Y” or “Determine whether these two nodes represent the same entity and merge them if supported.”
Only knowledge/**/*.md and index.md may change. Raw evidence is read-only; failed verification rolls back automatically.

Network metrics

Simple undirected projection · authored edges · no self-loops · parallel edges collapsed
Choose “Calculate” to derive global and node-level topology metrics from the selected knowledge base.

Machine-local services

Connections

Enable authenticated subscription clients. BioOKF removes API-key and cloud-provider variables before every agent run.

Credentials stay in their native clientsBioOKF Studio stores only these enable/disable switches. It never reads subscription tokens or API keys.
